text: That night: Holmes whispers that they must sit without light
why: In ¶226-229, during the night vigil, Holmes whispers that they must sit without light.

text: Which room does the ventilator open into? — Holmes says that he, next door, would see a light through it
why: ¶229 has Holmes say he would see a light through the ventilator, and ¶153 and ¶208 already establish that it links this room to Dr. Roylott's room next door.
